unit.why: A single anecdote: a suffering man brings the Maggid of Mezeritch a petition, the Maggid laughs aloud, and he explains to R. Elimelekh why he did so.

stories.start_quote: וסיפר מעשה מהמגיד קדוש ממעזריטש נ"ע
stories.end_quote: הדינין שעל האיש המשוגע וכן עשיתי לאיש הזה
stories.summary_en: When a man afflicted with troubles hands the Maggid of Mezeritch a petition, the Maggid laughs aloud; to the astonished R. Elimelekh of Lizhensk he explains that laughter draws down joy from the sefirah of Hokhmah and sweetens the harsh judgments, just as people laugh at a madman.

quotes: פ"א בא אליו איש מעונה בצרות ויסורים
tags.why: a supplicant comes to the Maggid with a petition
a pidyon nefesh is handed over and the decree is sweetened

tags.why: joy and laughter used as a spiritual remedy
